name: St Louis Spring Co.
old_description: The St. Louis Spring Company makes custom leaf spring suspension for almost any kind of vehicle.  We are one of the oldest continuously operating leaf spring manufacturers in the country.  Our second generation family-owned shop has been handcrafting custom leaf springs for America’s cars and vehicles using time-honored techniques for more than a hundred years.
about:
St. Louis Spring Company operates from St. Louis, Missouri, where it has handcrafted leaf springs for more than a century. The second-generation family-owned shop traces its roots to an unspecified founding date, making it one of the oldest continuously operating leaf spring manufacturers in the United States. Longtime operations manager Jim Christian has spent over 50 years with the company, rising from the shop floor to oversee production.

The company produces custom leaf spring suspensions for virtually any vehicle type, alongside a stock inventory of leaf springs, u-bolts, bushings, inserts, clips, and center bolts. Each spring is hand-assembled using heavy-duty, high-grade steel sourced from domestic mills. The shop handles everything from single-piece prototypes to replacement runs for fleets, though specific facility size and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers span a wide spectrum of mobility needs: classic cars, muscle cars, and hot rods; pickup trucks, Jeeps, SUVs, and vans; trailers, heavy-duty fire and dump trucks, commercial and semi trucks, tow trucks, and agricultural equipment. The company also serves niche applications such as demolition derby cars, monster trucks, golf carts, tractors, brush hogs, mobile homes, and RVs.

The firm emphasizes durability through U.S.-made steel, the ability to custom-fabricate any spring specification—including arch height changes, thicker material, or additional leaves—and a turnaround that typically falls within a week. Christian’s five-decade tenure is cited as a guarantee of process knowledge and consistent quality.
